mods.title: FNF: SONIC JAM!
mods.description: Welcome to SONIC JAMJAMMIN' NEW WEEKTake on the World's Most Famous Hedgehog in WEEK SONIC, a 3-song original level with songs inspired by the rich soundtracks of Sonic CD, Sonic R,Sonic Adventure, and beyond! Revisit a classic locale, experience dazzling hand-drawn cutscenes, and rhyme at super-sonic speeds! Can you keep up?PLAYABLE SONIC CAMPAIGNDr. Eggman's got a new path to world domination-- the POWER of MUSIC! Using his greatest creation, METAL SONIC, the Doctor's taking over the city's musical culture to harness its unlimited musical power. What's worse... is that they're convinced METAL SONIC is the REAL SONIC! But Sonic's not the slacker type. Take back the city's music and clear Sonic's name through intricately crafted 'Sonic Mixes' of FNF's unforgettable soundtrack. With 10+ remixes lovingly created from the ground up, you can check out a fresh, distinct take on Friday Night Funkin's music inspired by New Jack Swing, RNB, 90's House, Rock, Hip Hop, Chiptune, and many more. Face off against the worst of the worst, bring Metal Sonic's reign to an end, and free the spirit of music in Sonic's campaign.GO FOR PERFECTWhen you're playing as Sonic, simply hitting all the notes won't be enough for those brag-worthy P ranks. On top of beating a song flawlessly, you'll need to style on your enemies with a brand new taunt system. After hitting a combo, you'll be able to chain taunts to the rhythm until your next turn. Pull off a sweet chain, and you'll get crazy bonuses that'll shoot you straight to the top! Every SICK note you hit gets added to your SCORE, so be sure to rack up enough for a massive score bonus at the end. Make a name for yourself on the charts as the most stylish MC alive!

mods.title: THE FUNKIN' HILL 8
mods.description: (NO AI CODING IS USED THROUGHOUT THIS DEVELOPMENT. AS THE DEVELOPMENT STARTED IN OCTOBER 22ND!)"The Green Hill 8" BY Selbi, AS OF NOVEMBER 7TH, 2026, IS THE WINNER OF SONIC HACKING CONTEST 2026 AS PART OF ROM HACK ENTRY. TWICE.Herox/Arie's Note (in case people put it in YT descriptions):So before this mod was made, Selbi announced one of his upcoming Sonic ROM Hack, called "The Green Hill 8". The only thing I found out about this was Twitter/X in which Sonic Stadium made a tweet about Selbi's upcoming Sonic ROM Hack. And then when looking through Selbi's recent video, I immediately created the mod folder for Psych Engine as soon as I see it. Waited until its release.After the ROM Hack being released within' Sonic Hacking Contest 2026 (SHC2026), I just went and played it. And to be fair, it was a fun experience! Even if it was a fun experience, it also made me go insane hahahah! I then decided to make the song based on this by Selbi.There are 60 different anomalies in the original ROM Hack! I cut it down to 15 due to how many anomalies there are and is difficult to code them in!-HOW TO BEAT THE SONG IN PSYCH ENGINE:Due to how the custom Pause Menu existing in Psych Engine, you can actually use it for a useful reason! Because default FNF pause menu doesn't let you do that! All in LUA!For each 15 anomalies (plus 1), you must reset the song until you get to Act 8. If failed to recognize that it's an anomaly, it resets back to 0 and restarts the song in the process at the end of the song. After Act 8, you can now beat the song normally!Otherwise, Base Game users can beat the song as if nothing ever happened.-This FNF Sonic Mod and the original ROM Hack is based on "The Exit 8"! Play it here when you can!>> Selbi, if you're reading this, if you wish to do anything to this (like taking it down for example), do let me know and I'll follow your words! <<See also:SONIC IS ALONE.
